title: Low-Calorie Cauliflower Chicken Alfredo
summary: Fettuccine in a creamy Alfredo-style sauce of puréed cauliflower, skim milk, garlic and a little Parmigiano and Pecorino, topped with thin seared chicken breast.
notes: Video: 'The Best Low Calorie Alfredo Pasta Ever' on the Joshua Weissman Recipes channel (UCUAg71CJEvFdOnujmep1Svw). Written recipe for the same dish: https://www.joshuaweissman.com/recipes/easy-low-calorie-52g-protein-alfredo-pasta (serves 4, prep 10 min, cook 30 min; it publishes 470 kcal, 52 g protein, 53 g carbs, 6 g fat per serving, useful as a cross-check). The video states the chicken, milk, both cheeses (22 g each), garlic, bouillon and pasta. From the written recipe: the cauliflower weight (1 head, about 2 lb, before trimming, so it slightly overstates the florets). Our estimates: salt (1 tsp kosher) and pepper on the chicken. Not counted: the salt in the boiling water, the cooking spray, salt 'to taste' in the sauce, and the optional extra Parmigiano on top (he also leaves it out of his macros). He may not use all the sauce or all the milk; we count all of both.

steps.text: Cut the cauliflower into evenly sized florets, discarding the thick stem.
Boil the florets in well-salted water for 10-12 minutes, until completely soft and mushy.
Butterfly the chicken breasts into thin cutlets (flatten them with your palm if needed) and season both sides with salt and pepper.
Sear the chicken in a lightly sprayed skillet over medium-high heat, 2-3 minutes, flip, then 3-4 minutes more, until 165°F inside. Rest, then slice into thin strips.

Lift the cauliflower out of the water into a blender. Add half the milk, both cheeses, the raw garlic, the bouillon and a little salt, and blend until completely smooth. Loosen with more milk if needed and adjust the salt.
Boil the fettuccine in well-salted water until al dente.
Move the pasta with tongs into a pan with some of the sauce and a splash of pasta water, add more sauce and toss until glossy and creamy.
Divide into 4 bowls and top each with sliced chicken, plus extra Parmigiano and black pepper if you like.
